**Direct answer:** Sagg Eco Village is in the Ganderbal district of Kashmir, in the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir. The search snippets put it near Lar, in the Harmukh foothills, about 6 km from Ganderbal town. I could only confirm "Ganderbal" by reading a page. The finer detail comes from search snippets and is less certain.

**Claims and sources**

Confirmed by reading the page:
- It is located in Ganderbal, Jammu & Kashmir, India. https://ecovillage.org/map/community/sagg-eco-village/
- It describes itself as J&K's first eco village, started in 2013, and runs as a natural farm and cultural retreat center. https://ecovillage.org/map/community/sagg-eco-village/
- Its website is saggecovillage.earth. https://ecovillage.org/map/community/sagg-eco-village/

From search snippets only (I didn't open these pages, and the Mapcarta page returned a 403 error):
- The address is Watlar Wuder, Lar, Ganderbal, PIN 191201. Trip.com gives it as Lar – Chunt Waliwar Road, Ganderbal. https://sg.trip.com/travel-guide/attraction/ganderbal/sagg-eco-village-the-best-offbeat-recreational-destination-in-kashmir-141839954
- The coordinates are about 34.272°N, 74.760°E. https://mapcarta.com/N5931593287
- Justdial lists the locality as Warpora, Ganderbal, which differs slightly from the Lar address. https://www.justdial.com/Ganderbal/Sagg-Eco-Village-Ganderbal-ho/9999PX194-X194-220509221200-H3C3_BZDET

I didn't find the "Harmukh foothills" or "6 km from Ganderbal town" claims in any page I read, so treat them as unverified.
